listX.text: [L629-L630] (HIGH/incorrect state assignment) In the non-MPI multi-record-jump path, both q1 and q2 are assigned from gq2, so the earlier discharge record gq1 read at lines 612-615 is discarded and temporal interpolation uses the later record at both endpoints.

[L409-L416, L426-L434, L448-L472, L657-L664, L863-L866] (MED/unguarded division) Several Surfbeat and nonhydrostatic taper expressions divide by par%taper without the positive-taper guard used by the stationary branch, so an allowed zero taper would produce invalid boundary values.
[L678-L701] (MED/unimplemented option) The par%order==3 nonhydrostatic monochromatic branch contains only commented assignments, leaving s%zi and s%ui stale while accepting the option.

[L880-L884, L903-L907] (HIGH/MPI uninitialized state) The TS_NONH MPI path does not broadcast isSet_V, yet every rank tests it to set s%vi and s%isSet_Vbc, so non-master ranks use an undefined logical.

[L886-L899] (HIGH/MPI/serial inconsistency) TS_NONH discharge-to-velocity conversion guarded by isSet_Q exists only in the non-MPI preprocessor branch, so MPI runs distribute raw discharges as boundary velocities and also never broadcast isSet_Q.

[L1022-L1025, L1035-L1038] (HIGH/incorrect extrema update) All four hybrid-tide minimum updates call min with the corresponding maximum accumulator instead of the minimum accumulator, corrupting the observed ranges used to compute the hybrid coefficients.
[L1049, L1063] (MED/unguarded division) Hybrid relative error divides by the maximum observed range without a positive floor, so constant water-level windows can yield division by zero.

[L1511-L1515, L1551, L1581] (MED/conditional initialization) Saved Coriolis coefficient fc is initialized only when par%t<=par%dt, so a first invocation after a hot start or externally managed time can use an undefined value.

[L1785-L1798] (HIGH/MPI domain ownership) Vertical point discharges are clamped into each local subdomain and applied with no ownership test, causing every MPI rank to inject every point source at a local edge cell.

[L1961-L1973] (MED/invalid-input handling) An unrecognized scalar/vector mode is silently accepted and leaves saved lVarU at its prior value, so malformed or changed files can be parsed using stale layout state.

[L1860-L1868, L1915-L2012] (HIGH/stale parser state) Saved header indices iZ/iU/iV/idU/idV/iQ/iW/iT are not reset when a new boundary file is initialized, so variables absent from the new header can retain indices from the previous file.

[L1988-L2012, L2056-L2065] (MED/unclear file-format contract) Although the time-column index iT is detected, data columns are always addressed as header_index-1, implicitly requiring time to be the first header without validating or documenting that constraint.
[L2067-L2087] (HIGH/division by zero) For a boundary file with only one time level, EOF handling sets t1 equal to t0 and then immediately performs interpolation divided by t1-t0.

[L2171-L2183, L2240-L2253] (HIGH/undefined output flags) When EOF is reached during or before a regular call, values and isSet_Q are assigned but isSet_U/isSet_V/isSet_Z/isSet_W/isSet_dU/isSet_dV are not, despite all being intent(out) and subsequently consumed by callers.

listY.text: [L57-L113,L118-L125] (LOW/lifecycle/state) Saved allocation and `bccreated` state are initialized only for the first grid seen, with no reset or resizing contract for a later grid or reinitialization in the same process.
[L139-L164,L176-L203] (MED/input validation) The TS readers accept `nt` without requiring it to be positive and then allocate from it and divide `sum(dataE)` by `nt`.

[L426-L473,L657-L664,L863-L866] (HIGH/numerical robustness) Several Surfbeat and nonhydrostatic boundary branches evaluate `par%t/par%taper` without the zero-taper guard used by the stationary branch, so an allowed zero taper can inject NaNs.

[L434-L453,L470-L472,L684-L696] (HIGH/numerical robustness) Bound-wave and nonhydrostatic formulas divide by boundary depth, `sinh(kh)`, `tanh(kh)`, and the resonant term `cg**2-g*h` without dry-point or small-denominator protection.

[L490-L500,L594-L660] (MED/time interpolation) The spectral-record calculation divides by `dtbcfile` and derives direct-access record numbers from it without validating that this file-supplied interval is positive.

[L627-L631] (HIGH/serial/MPI divergence) In the non-MPI multi-record-jump branch, both `q1` and `q2` are assigned from `gq2`, whereas the MPI branch distributes `gq1` into `q1`, eliminating the intended discharge interpolation only in serial runs.

[L697-L701] (HIGH/incomplete branch) The `par%order==3` branch contains only commented-out assignments, leaving `s%zi` and `s%ui` at prior or undefined values while execution continues as if a third-order boundary had been generated.

[L854-L866] (HIGH/vector transformation) The difference-velocity rotation computes only `s%dUi`; `s%dVi` is neither replaced by the rotated transverse component nor included in the subsequent tapering.
[L868-L913] (HIGH/MPI state propagation) The TS_NONH MPI path broadcasts several `isSet_*` flags but omits `isSet_V`, after which every rank branches on that uninitialized local flag.

[L873-L899] (HIGH/serial/MPI divergence) When a TS_NONH file supplies discharge `Q`, conversion of `uig` and `duig` from discharge to velocity is compiled only in the non-MPI branch, so MPI runs distribute discharge values into velocity fields.

[L778-L780,L830-L832,L864,L1310-L1313] (HIGH/reference-level consistency) If a nonhydrostatic boundary file omits `Z`, `s%zi` is set to the absolute neighboring surface `s%zs(2,:)`, but the applied boundary later adds `s%zs0` to `s%zi`, apparently adding the mean level twice.

[L963-L983] (LOW/lifecycle/state) Flow-boundary work arrays are sized only on the first call, and `zs0old` is allocated only if the first call's tide type is instant or hybrid, leaving later dimension or tide-mode changes unsupported.
[L998-L999,L1029-L1042,L1141-L1146,L1363-L1365] (MED/parameter validation) Hybrid averaging and relaxation divide by combinations of `cats`, `Trep`, and `hybtavg` without enforcing positive values.

[L1022-L1038] (HIGH/accumulator defect) All four hybrid minimum updates call `min` with the corresponding maximum accumulator instead of the previous minimum, so historical minima are lost whenever later samples rise.
[L1047-L1071] (HIGH/numerical robustness) Hybrid relative error divides by the maximum observed surface range without a positive floor, producing a zero denominator for constant-level windows.
[L1177-L1178,L1386-L1387] (MED/numerical robustness) Boundary mean velocities divide by globally accumulated metric lengths without checking for an empty or zero-width boundary selection.

[L1202-L1247,L1263-L1271,L1321-L1324,L1399-L1422,L1432-L1451] (MED/boundary numerical robustness) Several absorbing-boundary formulas use unguarded water depths, group velocity, grid spacing, or angular denominators even though these branches do not consistently mask dry or degenerate boundary points.

[L1250-L1278,L1439-L1444] (MED/angle calculation) Incident and reflected directions are obtained with one-argument `atan` of a quotient, losing quadrant information and becoming discontinuous near zero longitudinal velocity.

[L1458-L1468] (HIGH/copy/paste indexing) Back-boundary corner water levels use `dzs0dn(1,...)` and `zb(1,...)` instead of the `nx+1` back-boundary row, applying front-boundary geometry at both back corners.
[L1511-L1515] (LOW/initialization) Saved Coriolis parameter `fc` is initialized only when `par%t<=par%dt`, so a first call after that interval, such as a hot-start entry, uses an undefined value.
[L1523-L1603] (MED/dispatch contract) The lateral-boundary `select case` has no default assignment, so an unsupported `bctype` returns an undefined `vbc` vector.

[L1549-L1602] (LOW/small-grid indexing) Three lateral-boundary cases populate only indices `2:s%nx` before copying from indices 2 and `s%nx`, which leaves circular or undefined endpoint values when `s%nx<2`.

[L1659-L1678] (HIGH/MPI domain intersection) A horizontal discharge segment is considered local only when at least one endpoint lies in the rank's box, so a segment that crosses a subdomain while both endpoints lie outside that subdomain is omitted there.

[L1777-L1798] (HIGH/MPI source duplication) Vertical point discharge clamps the global point into every rank's local index range without an ownership test, causing every MPI rank to apply the source at some local cell.
[L1961-L1973] (MED/input validation) An unrecognized scalar/vector mode is silently accepted and leaves saved `lVaru` at its previous-file value.

[L1860-L1868,L1915-L2012] (HIGH/stale parser state) Saved header indices are not reset when a new boundary file is initialized, so variables omitted by the new file can retain column indices from the previous file.

[L1868,L1988-L2012,L2056-L2083,L2259-L2311] (MED/file-format contract) Although the header parser records the position of `T`, the data reader always consumes time as the first field and maps every other variable as column index minus one, making non-first time columns unsupported without validation.

[L1988-L2011] (LOW/input normalization) Multi-character headers are matched against only selected capitalization variants, so otherwise accepted case variants such as `du`, `Dv`, or `DQ` can be silently ignored.

[L2067-L2127,L2185-L2228] (HIGH/time interpolation) A one-record file sets `t1=t0` and duplicate timestamps are otherwise permitted, yet all initialized variables are interpolated by dividing by `t1-t0`.

[L2171-L2183,L2240-L2253] (HIGH/output initialization) Both end-of-file return paths assign only `isSet_Q`; the other `intent(out)` presence flags are left undefined even though callers immediately use them to accept or replace returned fields.

[L274,L420-L421,L914-L916] (MED/dispatch contract) Unsupported wave-boundary combinations fall through empty branches without an error or deterministic reset, allowing boundary arrays to retain values from an earlier condition.

[L918-L922] (LOW/update scope) Final long-wave scaling is applied to the entire saved `s%ui` field rather than only the boundary row populated here, creating an unclear repeated-scaling contract for interior entries.

listX.text: [L50-L54,L67] (LOW/persistent allocation) The saved gamma workspace is allocated only once and never checked against later grid dimensions, leaving an undocumented fixed-grid-size lifetime contract.
[L56-L72] (MED/numerical robustness) Although hhw is protected against dry or negative depth, gamma is computed with the unclamped s%hh, so zero-depth cells can produce infinities or NaNs in hstokes.
[L75-L115] (MED/configuration validation) The wavemodel select has no default case, so an unsupported value silently performs no wave update.

listY.text: [L50-L54] (MED/saved-shape state) The saved gamma work array is never resized if the grid dimensions change.
[L64-L73] (HIGH/dry-cell division) The new hstokes path computes H/hh across the full grid without a positive depth floor, so dry zero-depth cells can produce invalid gamma and zero hstokes.

[L78-L80, L89-L91] (HIGH/periodic scheduling) Wave updates depend on the timestep landing within 0.001*dt of an exact wavint multiple, so non-commensurate dt and wavint values can skip all later scheduled updates.
[L78, L89] (MED/unguarded modulo) The update schedule evaluates mod(t,wavint) without validating a positive nonzero wavint.

listX.text: [L73-L80,L234-L242] (HIGH/build failure) generate_wave_boundary_surfbeat assigns misspelled undeclared durantionlength and contains an unmatched endif, so the module cannot compile under implicit none.

[L100-L108,L234-L238] (HIGH/repeat-state contract) The repeatwbc path skips initialization of local wp but returns wp%rtbc, and bccount is incremented only in a local copy rather than written back to waveSpectrumAdministration.
[L127-L135,L315-L328] (MED/input validation) The instat select has no default, so an unsupported value leaves specin pointer components uninitialized before they are dereferenced.
[L197,L2376] (HIGH/build failure) generate_swts is called with two arguments even though its explicit module procedure accepts only wp.

[L208-L225,L1826-L1832] (MED/resource management) Cleanup deallocates pointer-containing spectrum/vargen parents without deallocating their pointed-to arrays, leaking allocations on each generated series.

[L394,L528,L666-L671,L687-L688,L1459,L1476,L1662-L1672] (HIGH/numerical robustness) Zero-energy spectra and removed partitions reach unguarded divisions; in particular a zero scalefac1 can turn the overlap convergence metric into NaN and prevent its unbounded loop from terminating.

[L862-L881,L1293-L1309] (HIGH/spectrum-axis handling) The SWAN reader notes non-monotonic frequencies but performs only no-op conversion before integration and 2-D interpolation assume ordered absolute frequencies.
[L897-L962,L1124-L1172] (MED/bounds/input validation) SWAN and variance-density inputs index angle entries 1 and 2 without enforcing nang>=2.

[L1324-L1340] (HIGH/indexing) When restoring a nonzero Sf into an empty interpolated bin, output-grid index i is used to index specin%S, which can exceed specin%nf and does not identify the corresponding input frequency.
[L1515-L1520] (HIGH/scientific formula) The nonhydrostatic cutoff frequency omits the square root from the dispersion relation, yielding dimensionally incorrect filtering.
[L1578-L1619] (HIGH/conditional implementation) Without BUILDXBEACH the interpolation blocks are empty, leaving pdflocal and thetagen undefined while the routine continues to normalize and use them.
[L1587-L1606] (MED/sampling/CDF) Simple-sum PDF normalization followed by trapezoidal CDF accumulation leaves the final CDF below one, so some random draws fall outside the interpolation range.
[L1766-L1771] (LOW/time-axis contract) rtin is recorded as tslen*dtin although tin ends at (tslen-1)*dtin.
[L1843-L1846] (HIGH/numerical robustness) Variance is rescaled by (hm0/hm0post)^2 without guarding hm0post=0.
[L1948-L1952] (MED/numerical robustness) Spatial spectrum interpolation rescales by sfimp/sfnow without guarding sfnow=0.

[L2035-L2085] (HIGH/uninitialized state/build failure) Direction distribution allocates with uninitialized lntheta, uses uninitialized ldtheta, never allocates WDindex, indexes binedges with wave index i instead of itheta, and references undefined par_px.
[L2167-L2189,L2301-L2304] (HIGH/build failure) BUILDXBEACH logging references s%ntheta and s%ny in generate_ebcf although no s object is in scope.

[L2243-L2256] (HIGH/state corruption) Inside the iy loop, scalar zeta(iy,...) values are assigned to the entire lastwaveelevation(:,itheta) column, so every boundary point is repeatedly overwritten with one point's elevation.
[L2338-L2341] (HIGH/time-axis corruption) Each loop iteration assigns one scalar time to the entire internal tbc slice, leaving all finite time entries equal to the final loop value.

[L2346-L2359] (HIGH/time-series indexing/shape) Interpolated samples use (it-1)*dtbc while storage time uses (it-2)*dtbc, and the no-interpolation whole-array assignment assumes tslen equals tslenbc although Kmin can make those extents differ.
[L2500-L2516] (HIGH/build failure) generate_qbcf allocates q using s%ny even though no s object is declared or passed.

[L2638-L2664] (HIGH/array conformance) The per-point phase shift multiplies K-by-K matrices by whole npb-length distx/disty vectors instead of distx(j)/disty(j), producing nonconformable array expressions.
[L2693-L2698] (HIGH/allocation/build failure) Hydrostatic output uses undeclared tslenbc, allocates qxbct twice, and never allocates qybct before writing it.
[L2698-L2712] (HIGH/time-series indexing/shape) Flux interpolation repeats the one-step time offset, while direct assignments require q's tslen to conform to tslenbc.

listY.text: [L73-L242] (HIGH/compile-time structural defects) The main generator references undeclared par, s, and bcfiles, assigns misspelled undeclared durantionlength, and contains an unmatched endif at line 240, so this routine cannot compile under implicit none.
[L100-L108, L234-L235] (HIGH/undefined repeat duration) The repeatwbc branch never initializes local wp, yet the routine obtains the returned duration from wp%rtbc after that branch.

[L120-L142, L247-L330] (MED/multi-location consistency) Each spectrum location can overwrite the shared wp%rtbc and wp%dtbc, but no check requires all locations to use the same series duration and sampling interval.

[L208-L225, L729-L733, L1469-L1488] (LOW/pointer-target leak) Deallocating containers such as specin, specinterp, scaledspec, vargen, and combspec does not deallocate their pointer components, and tempSf and avgscale are also left allocated, causing repeated-generation memory growth.

[L237-L238] (HIGH/administration state not persisted) The generator increments only the module shortcut bccount and never writes it back to waveSpectrumAdministration%bccount, so later calls continue to behave as the first boundary series.

[L624-L671] (HIGH/invalid convergence arithmetic) The partition iteration explicitly permits scalefac1 to become zero and then divides by scalefac1 in its convergence metric, producing infinities or NaNs.

[L635-L676] (HIGH/spectral overlap logic) After zeroing all but the dominant partition in each overlapping spectral cell, the final assignment rebuilds every scaledspec from the full original partition, discarding the overlap mask.

[L682-L719] (MED/invalid overlap diagnostic) A fully removed partition can make the peak-based ratio compute 0/0, and the resulting ratio-minus-one is then described as percent energy overlap even though it is a pointwise amplitude scaling.
[L854-L881] (HIGH/unimplemented frequency conversion) SWAN relative-frequency input (RFREQ) is detected but the documented conversion to absolute frequency is a no-op marked STILL TO BE DONE.

[L861-L925, L1064-L1078, L1111-L1172, L1224-L1238] (MED/spectral-axis validation) Readers index the second direction element and pass frequency/direction axes onward without enforcing at least two bins and strict monotonic order, despite later integration and interpolation depending on those properties.

[L1293-L1302, L1305-L1309, L1324-L1327] (HIGH/non-monotonic interpolation inconsistency) The code explicitly allows a non-monotonic input frequency axis but computes signed cell widths and passes that same axis to interpolation routines that require an ordered coordinate.

[L1334-L1339] (HIGH/out-of-bounds indexing) The zero-directional-interpolation fallback indexes specin%S with the standard-grid index i, which can run to 801 even when the input spectrum has fewer frequency rows.

[L1344-L1354, L1458-L1476, L1651-L1672] (MED/zero-energy handling) Wave direction, peak frequency, and representative-period calculations divide by spectral sums without guarding an all-zero or threshold-empty spectrum.
[L1361-L1375] (HIGH/compile-time unresolved symbol) set_repeatwbc references bcfiles without qualifying it through waveSpectrumAdministration or declaring a local alias.

[L1515-L1520] (HIGH/incorrect dispersion formula) The nonhydrostatic frequency cutoff uses g*k*tanh(kh)/(2π) instead of sqrt(g*k*tanh(kh))/(2π), giving dimensionally and numerically incorrect cutoff frequencies.

[L1587-L1619] (MED/CDF normalization) The directional PDF is normalized by its discrete sum but its trapezoidal CDF is not renormalized to end at one, so upper-tail random draws lie outside the constructed CDF range.
[L1618-L1619] (MED/angle normalization) MOD can return a negative generated direction, contradicting the stated 0<=theta<2π invariant.

[L1697-L1713, L1534-L1549, L1761] (HIGH/empty-frequency-range handling) If no spectral bin survives the threshold and cutoff, frange returns coincident default indices, leading to dfgen=0 and subsequent division by dfgen.
[L1766-L1771] (LOW/off-by-one duration) wp%rtin is recorded as tslen*dtin while the generated time axis ends at (tslen-1)*dtin.
[L1795-L1805] (HIGH/compile-time unresolved symbol) generate_wave_time_axis assigns ind_end_taper even though that name is neither declared locally nor present in the datastore.
[L1843-L1846] (HIGH/division by zero) Wave-train variance rescaling divides by hm0post without guarding a zero interpolated spectrum.
[L1932-L1952] (MED/unguarded spatial interpolation) Spatial spectrum interpolation neither rejects coincident spectrum positions nor guards sfnow=0 before rescaling by sfimp/sfnow.
[L197-L198, L2376-L2385] (HIGH/procedure interface mismatch) generate_swts is called with two arguments (wp,s) but is defined with only wp.
[L2035-L2137] (HIGH/compile-time/uninitialized directional grid) lntheta and ldtheta are never assigned before allocation and looping, wp%WDindex is used without allocation, and par_px is undeclared.

[L2079-L2096] (HIGH/out-of-bounds/wrong index) The wraparound-bin test uses binedges(i,...) where i is the wave-component index up to K rather than binedges(itheta,...), so it can read outside the directional-bin array and tests the wrong bin.
[L2124] (MED/division by zero) The lost-energy percentage divides by lostvar+keptvar without a zero-total-energy guard.
[L2142-L2369] (HIGH/compile-time unresolved symbols) generate_ebcf repeatedly uses undeclared ntheta, s, lastwaveelevation, and ind_end_taper instead of the available datastore-qualified fields.

[L2249-L2256] (HIGH/cross-point state overwrite) Inside the iy loop, a scalar elevation for point iy is assigned to the entire lastwaveelevation(:,itheta) vector, so each boundary point overwrites continuation state for all points.
[L2285-L2295] (HIGH/division by zero) Directional envelope scaling divides by stdeta without handling a zero total excitation.
[L2339-L2341] (HIGH/time-axis construction) Each loop iteration assigns one scalar time to the entire interior tbc slice, leaving all finite time entries equal to the last loop value.

[L2346-L2358] (HIGH/off-by-one/shape mismatch) The resampling branch queries (it-1)*dtbc for an output slot corresponding to (it-2)*dtbc, while the no-resampling branch assigns a tslen array into a tslenbc slice without ensuring equal extents.
[L2460-L2729] (HIGH/compile-time unresolved symbols) generate_qbcf uses undeclared s, tslenbc, and non-BUILDXBEACH interpolation symbols, preventing a valid build as written.
[L2562-L2588] (HIGH/singular interaction coefficients) Difference-wave group velocity and interaction coefficients divide by k3 and a resonance denominator without masks for zero or near-zero values.

[L2606-L2609] (HIGH/invalid complex logarithm) Phase is computed with log of Fourier coefficients that can be exactly zero for zero-amplitude components, propagating undefined phases into later complex products.

[L2661-L2669] (HIGH/array-shape defect) Boundary unrolling multiplies K-shaped matrices by whole npb-length distx and disty arrays rather than distx(j) and disty(j), producing nonconformable shapes or unintended element mapping.
[L2693-L2697] (HIGH/allocation defect) qxbct is allocated twice while qybct is never allocated, so the second allocation fails and later qybct assignments target an unallocated array.
[L2698-L2712] (HIGH/off-by-one/shape mismatch) Long-wave resampling repeats the one-step time offset and unchecked tslen-to-tslenbc shape assignment used by the energy path.

listX.text: [L52-L91, L131-L152] (HIGH/fragile first-call initialization) Saved administration is initialized only when t equals dt within 1e-6, so hot starts or externally managed first calls can use undefined reuse, counter, bcendtime, rt, and dt.
[L69-L86] (HIGH/non-master undefined state) testc is read only by the master but is tested on every rank to set saved reuse, with the corresponding broadcasts explicitly commented out.
[L93-L98] (LOW/unreachable cleanup) The CLOSE intended for the last timestep is placed after RETURN and can never execute.
[L157-L162] (MED/empty weighted average) For a minimal 2-D grid with ny=1, the offshore-depth average uses empty slices and divides by a zero sum.
[L314-L378] (LOW/periodic-grid quadrature) The parametric directional grid includes both -π and π and normalizes them with a rectangular sum, double-counting the identical periodic endpoint.
[L463-L498] (HIGH/unimplemented frequency conversion) SWAN RFREQ input is recognized but its conversion to absolute frequency is a no-op.
[L465-L472, L627-L649] (HIGH/unbounded malformed-input loop) SWAN keyword searches perform reads without IOSTAT or EOF handling and can loop indefinitely on a truncated or malformed file.

[L474-L593, L723-L749, L805-L881] (MED/spectral-axis validation) SWAN and VarDens inputs are used without requiring at least two directions or strictly increasing frequency and direction axes, despite direct second-element indexing, quadrature, and interpolation.
[L981-L1036, L1872-L1905] (HIGH/empty/degenerate spectral range) An empty threshold range makes M zero and a single-bin range makes K=1 and df=0, causing divisions by M, K-1, and df.

[L1194-L1210] (HIGH/zero-energy rescaling) Hm0 correction divides by hm0now and directional-width construction divides by S0 without a zero-energy contract; the small S0 floor does not protect hm0now.
[L1222-L1244] (HIGH/FFT index bounds) Generated frequency indices are written into CompFn without verifying that they lie below the Nyquist slot or within the Nr-length FFT array.

[L1280-L1337] (HIGH/uninitialized directional-bin indices) Nbin is never initialized, and a direction shifted once by 2π can still fall outside a computational sector narrower than 2π, leaving its bin entry undefined before maxval and nspr handling.
[L1342-L1352] (MED/zero window normalization) If no generated time sample is at or below rt, temp is all zero and the taper divides by maxval(temp)=0.
[L1450-L1457] (HIGH/zero-envelope division) Directional envelope amplitude divides by stdeta without handling a zero total elevation signal.
[L1453-L1454] (LOW/standard-deviation denominator) The expressions size(array-1) return the full sample count rather than size(array)-1 as the surrounding standard-deviation comments imply.

[L1497-L1510] (MED/boundary-type mismatch) Symmetric parametric energy redistribution tests WBCTYPE_PARAMS even though this generator is entered for WBCTYPE_PARAMETRIC, so the intended parametric branch may never run.

[L1095-L1105, L1517-L1525] (HIGH/time-origin mismatch) The synthesized record starts at t=dt, but record 1 is written as the first boundary sample and the consumer treats direct-access record 1 as time zero.
[L1637-L1668] (HIGH/singular interaction coefficients) Bound-wave group velocity and interaction coefficients divide by k3 and a resonance denominator without zero or near-resonance masks.
[L1691-L1699] (HIGH/invalid complex logarithm) Bound-wave phase takes the logarithm of Fourier coefficients without excluding exact zero coefficients.
[L1703-L1709] (HIGH/direction quadrant loss) Difference-wave direction uses atan(KKy/KKx) with a signed epsilon instead of atan2, losing the correct quadrant whenever KKx is negative.

[L1789-L1794] (HIGH/curvilinear rotation quadrant loss) Flux rotation derives its angle from atan(qy/max(qx,eps)), which replaces every negative qx with a positive epsilon and therefore gives incorrect quadrants and components.
[L1922-L1932] (MED/zero spectral moment) Representative-period formulas divide by spectral moments without guarding zero energy or, for Tm-1,0, zero frequency.
[L1963-L1993] (MED/zero-frequency/depth dispersion) bc_disper evaluates 0/0 for zero angular frequency and divides by h without enforcing a positive boundary depth.

listY.text: [L69-L89,L107-L118,L478-L489,L502-L533,L613-L666,L801-L850] (HIGH/MPI state distribution) Master-only input populates testc, dimensions, switches, factors, and spectrum arrays while all corresponding broadcasts are commented out, leaving non-master ranks to branch on uninitialized values, allocate with undefined extents, and compute from undefined data.
[L93-L98] (LOW/resource management) The close(74) intended for the final timestep is unreachable after return, leaving a FILELIST unit open.
[L157-L162] (HIGH/bounds/numerical robustness) The ny>0 branch uses slices 2:ny, so ny=1 produces empty sums and division by zero instead of using the single offshore point.

[L164-L179] (MED/input validation) An unsupported wbctype silently skips every spectrum builder but execution still advances list state and writes administration entries from stale or uninitialized wave parameters.

[L260,L311,L1016-L1017,L1057-L1059,L1194-L1205,L1922-L1932] (HIGH/numerical robustness) Zero wave height is accepted but multiple subsequent spectral normalizations and representative-period calculations divide by zero.
